name: n_adsorbates
definition: Number of adsorbed H atoms, from the pre-relaxation geometry

name: is_2H
definition: 1 for two-adsorbate configurations, 0 otherwise; indicator for the pair block

name: n_water
definition: Co-adsorbed water molecules, i.e. oxygens carrying H but bonded to no Ir; their hydrogens are excluded from n_adsorbates

name: n_atoms
definition: Total atoms in the configuration

name: cn_mean
definition: Mean Ir-O coordination number of the binding oxygen(s), cutoff 2.6 A

name: cn_min
definition: Minimum coordination number across binding oxygens

name: cn_max
definition: Maximum coordination number across binding oxygens

name: gcn_mean
definition: Mean generalised coordination number, sum_j CN(j)/6 (Calle-Vallejo)

name: gcn_min
definition: Minimum generalised coordination number across binding oxygens

name: gcn_max
definition: Maximum generalised coordination number across binding oxygens

name: n_bridge_sites
definition: Binding oxygens with Ir coordination 2 (bridging)

name: n_3f_sites
definition: Binding oxygens with Ir coordination 3 (three-fold)

name: d_OH_mean_A
definition: Mean H to binding-oxygen distance in the built geometry

name: nn1_dist_A
definition: Mean distance from binding oxygen to its 1st nearest heavy atom

name: nn2_dist_A
definition: Mean distance from binding oxygen to its 2nd nearest heavy atom

name: nn3_dist_A
definition: Mean distance from binding oxygen to its 3rd nearest heavy atom

name: frac_Ir_in_shell
definition: Fraction of atoms within 2.6 A of the binding oxygen that are Ir

name: z_site_A
definition: Mean z coordinate of the binding oxygen(s)

name: z_below_top_A
definition: Depth of the binding oxygen below the topmost slab atom

name: lateral_margin_A
definition: Distance from the binding site to the nearest lateral edge of the non-periodic slab; low values mean coordination is truncated by the finite cell

name: pair_separation_A
definition: Distance between the two binding oxygens (2H only, else 0)

name: pair_hh_separation_A
definition: Distance between the two H atoms (2H only, else 0)

name: pair_cos_theta_z
definition: Cosine of the angle between the O-O pair vector and the surface normal (2H only, else 0)

name: pair_inplane_angle_deg
definition: In-plane angle of the O-O pair vector from the x axis (2H only, else 0)

name: pair_same_row
definition: 1 if the pair vector lies along a lateral axis, i.e. same bridging-oxygen row (2H only, else 0)
